    if 'matrix' not in case:

            raise ValueError("all rows must be lists of equal length")

    idf = []

        row_degree.append(sum(weighted_row))
    return {
        "idf": idf,
        "row_degree": row_degree,
        "weighted_matrix": weighted_matrix
    }
